Kontablo — Universal Accounting Ontology [active, published]
An Esperanto for accounting: graph-based ontology mapping the 195 sovereign jurisdictions to IFRS/XBRL and to the agentic economy (MCP · A2A · AP2). One immutable UUID per universal accounting concept; deterministic three-tier resolution.
  - 195 sovereign jurisdictions mapped; 60 statutory chart-of-accounts overlays (56 exercised against primary sources) (https://github.com/ChristianLuciani/accounting-esperanto)
  - Published June 2026 under Business Source License 1.1 (converts to Apache 2.0 in 2030); preprint deposited on Zenodo and SSRN (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20738795)

Drahma — Educational Synthetic Intelligence [active, published]
36 Socratic virtual tutors for the Ecuadorian curriculum, field-tested in the Amazon (Aug 2024) — roughly two months before Khanmigo went public. Built without external funding; model-agnostic via Poe; guardrails for minors.
  - 36 Socratic virtual tutors for the Ecuadorian curriculum, field-tested with Amazonian indigenous communities (Aug 2024) (https://github.com/DRAHMAN-ORG/drahman-org)

ZENTROPY — Zero Entropy Intelligence Station [active]
Personal cognitive operating system — captures, distills and organizes synthetic-cognition conversations. Solves dialectical entropy: flashes of clarity that vanish get stored in a structured database (Supabase). Universal ingestion: Claude JSON/ZIP, ChatGPT, Markdown.

Esteléctica — Epistemology of Distilled Poly-dialectical Dialogue [experimental]
Philosophical proposal and software architecture about the nature of collective knowledge in the age of synthetic cognition. Trunk/Rhizome model: the rhizome explores freely; the human–synthetic-cognition pair periodically distills toward the Trunk. Integrates Noesis and Noetix.

CLAPPS.AI — Comprehensive Learning Applications [planning]
Self-taught human-development platform — a counterpoint to the traditional LMS model. Structured, dynamic support for long-term skill development. Closest current reference: NotebookLM, but without structured competency progression.

NOOS — Natural Organization Operating System [experimental]
Reduce organizational entropy through distributed synthetic cognition and knowledge graphs. Organizations modeled as thermodynamic systems with high/low-entropy states. Destination: high-value consulting for organizations in digital transition.

Topia — Newsletter Editorial Engine [planning]
From dystopia to achievable eutopias: a newsletter with epistemic rigor — one essay at a time, every claim traced, every thesis falsifiable. Maps the path to technological sovereignty, collective cognition and regenerative economies.

Nelson Companion [active]

profile-as-code — pasco [active, published]
Spec-driven engine that compiles one versionable source of truth into every public profile surface: per-platform renderers, deterministic (byte-stable) output, schema-validated facts and a per-entry deploy ledger. This very profile is generated by it.
  - Open source (MIT), spec-first contract (docs/SPEC.md, D1–D22) with CI gates on schema, package inventory, doc links and the project site; the README you are reading is its dogfood output (https://github.com/ChristianLuciani/profile-as-code)
  - Renders are deterministic and gated: every artifact is a pure function of the SSOT, and drift is a warning while a schema violation fails the build (https://github.com/ChristianLuciani/profile-as-code/blob/main/docs/ci-cd.md)

Q: What is Kontablo?
A: Kontablo is an Esperanto for accounting: a graph-based ontology mapping the 195 sovereign jurisdictions to IFRS/XBRL and to the agentic economy (MCP, A2A, AP2) — one immutable UUID per universal accounting concept, deterministic three-tier resolution.

Q: What is Drahma and what did it prove?
A: Drahma is 36 Socratic virtual tutors for the Ecuadorian curriculum, field-tested with Amazonian communities in August 2024 — built without external funding, model-agnostic via Poe, with guardrails for minors.

Q: What does Christian Luciani work on?
A: Complex systems, synthetic cognition for human learning and sovereign open-source infrastructure — from a field-tested educational AI (Drahma) to a universal accounting ontology (Kontablo).

Q: Does Christian Luciani take consulting work?
A: Yes — strategic systems consulting with a sovereign-first approach: BI platforms, ERP (Zoho, ERPNext), cash-audit systems and SaaS architecture, where the client keeps the code and the data.
